required_stages.description: Allocate weights (M, k) in logits.dtype and indices (M, k) int32 inside run().
Read each row of logits once, upcast to float32, pad positions beyond E with -inf.
k sequential rounds of full-row max + argmax; record value and int32 index into slot i; exclude the chosen column with -inf; output order is descending.
Numerically stable float32 softmax (max-subtract, exp, sum, divide) over only the k selected values; padded slots contribute 0.
Store weights cast to logits.dtype and int32 indices; fused with the previous stages in one launch.

forbidden_substitutions.message: torch.topk replaces the whole selection stage.
Host-side sort/argsort replaces the selection stage.
Host-side softmax/exp replaces the normalisation stage.
Host-side max/argmax/gather assembles the outputs with PyTorch.
Host-side dtype conversion of logits or of the outputs is an extra pass; conversions belong inside the kernel.
No initialised global scratch is part of this operator.
A host-side copy of logits inside run() is not permitted.

required_evidence.message: No kernel-level argmax found; the selection must be done in the kernel.
No kernel-level exp found for the softmax stage.
No -inf masking value found; exclusion of selected columns and padding must use -inf.

outputs.aliasing: none; (weights (M, k) in logits.dtype, indices (M, k) int32) both freshly allocated inside run() and not sharing storage with logits

timing_boundary.notes: Everything inside run() is timed: the two output allocations, host-side derivation of padded widths from E and k, and the single fused kernel. No cached state, no host-side cast, copy or partial selection of logits.
